text:
How to Play:

  1. Player 1 chooses a noun, e.g. ‘bicycle’.
  2. Player 2 adds a determiner, e.g. ‘a bicycle’. This is a noun phrase.
  3. Player 1 adds an adjective, e.g. ‘a green bicycle’. This is an expanded noun phrase.
  4. Player 2 adds another adjective, e.g. ‘a big, green bicycle’.
  5. Take it in turns to add adjectives until it gets too silly!
  6. Try again with a different noun.


You can use this table to help you think of words (or make up your own):

Nouns Determiners Adjectives
bicycle, cat, robot, dinosaur, princess, table, sock, rabbit, wagon, Grandpa, Linda, pencil, castle, tree a, an, the, my, your, her, our, its, their, this, that, these, those, one, two, three, several, another, many, some green, spiky, hilarious, beautiful, scary, enormous, sparkly, tired, baggy, fresh, juicy, horrible
Work together to build an expanded noun phrase. You don’t need to write anything down for this game – just say your ideas!
